boundaryGate.question: P4 real-machine gate: after accepted Core/Alembic/Dashboard P0-P3 changes, does the restored Panorama dashboard show AlembicWorkspace space-member data only, avoid BiliDili cross-space leakage, keep BiliDili's own dashboard behavior intact, and leave the rescan incremental chain working?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real local projects only: AlembicWorkspace space/controlRoot as primary subject, BiliDili projectRoot as regression contrast, accepted local commits Core 73cb9a340a4044eed68977d5ddbc36491deda674 / Alembic 9ccca4b212cacf022a8d46fc13f92f666cd4376e / Dashboard a1070f2ab52dbea06e94511892e2876074a2af9c. P4 verifies runtime behavior and evidence; it does not edit source code or accept P5 UI fidelity.
controllerSelfChecks: P0 accepted directAligned=false and CG-E downgrade contract; per-module recipeCount cannot be faked from files.
P1 Core accepted scope discovery guard + health/gaps rollup.
P2 Alembic accepted /panorama, /panorama/health, /panorama/gaps endpoint family and space-view aggregation.
P3 Dashboard accepted four-tab UI restore and P2 endpoint binding; local Dashboard check/build/test passed.
Known P3 residual: target browser saw backend 500s locally, so success-payload visual/data validation belongs to this P4 real-machine run.
realScenarioConditions: Run against the real AlembicWorkspace space/controlRoot, not BiliDili as the primary subject and not a sandbox copy.
Use the local configured Alembic/Dashboard runtime for Codex-hosted testing; do not switch to another AI host or introduce external AI execution for this verification.
Use BiliDili only as the regression contrast for its own projectRoot dashboard and for proving no BiliDili entries leak into AlembicWorkspace Panorama.
If a rebuild/bootstrap/rescan is necessary, keep it scoped to the test workspaces and preserve raw logs/commands.
successMeans: AlembicWorkspace Dashboard /panorama renders four tabs: overview, dependencies, graph, gaps.
Raw responses from /panorama, /panorama/health, and /panorama/gaps are captured and show projectScope/memberRoots scoped to AlembicWorkspace members only.
Overview statistics, health, and gaps are populated or explicitly degraded according to accepted CG-E; no file-count apportioning or fabricated per-module recipeCount is presented.
No BiliDili projectRoot/module/path/recipe entry appears in AlembicWorkspace Panorama raw responses or screenshots.
BiliDili's own projectRoot Dashboard still renders/returns its own panorama or documented empty/single-project shape without AlembicWorkspace leakage.
A real rescan run or narrowly justified equivalent proves the incremental chain still completes without snapshot-table deletion or forced full rebuild dependency.
failureMeans: Any BiliDili entry appears in AlembicWorkspace panorama data or UI.
AlembicWorkspace panorama tabs render only static shell/error states when the backend should be available.
Endpoint data shape contradicts the accepted P2 contract or hides CG-E downgrade as fake module-level recipe counts.
BiliDili dashboard regresses or shows AlembicWorkspace data.
Rescan fails because this demand changed snapshot/rescan/discovery behavior.
Required raw endpoint responses, screenshots, or rescan logs are missing.
cannotConclude: Do not conclude P5 old-UI fidelity; P5 is separate reference comparison.
Do not conclude production release readiness, push readiness, or tag readiness.
Do not use BiliDili alone as proof of space behavior because it is a single-project contrast.
Do not treat target prose without raw endpoint/screenshot/log evidence as acceptance.
stopConditions: Wrong active project/controlRoot is detected before destructive or rebuild-like operations.
Required Alembic/Dashboard service cannot be started or endpoint credentials/config are missing.
Raw evidence shows cross-space leakage, fake apportioning, or rescan chain failure.
Any operation would require source edits, push/tag/release, or broad data-root cleanup outside the test boundary.

evidenceRequired: Raw JSON or summarized raw payloads for /panorama, /panorama/health, /panorama/gaps under AlembicWorkspace.
A negative leakage check listing searched BiliDili identifiers/paths and showing absent from AlembicWorkspace responses/UI.
Rescan command/status/log evidence showing incremental chain non-regression.
Explicit pass/fail conclusion for each of the three P4 gates.
allowedOperations: Start/stop local Alembic/Dashboard services needed for verification.
Call the three panorama endpoints and related graph/dependency endpoints, saving bounded raw JSON summaries.
Capture screenshots for the four AlembicWorkspace tabs and BiliDili contrast.
Run a scoped rescan or equivalent accepted runtime verification and collect logs/status JSON.
Inspect local runtime logs, SQLite/read-only data, and generated artifacts needed to prove scope membership.
forbiddenOperations: No source code edits or commits in Test.
No deletion of project_context_file_snapshots or bootstrap_snapshots.
No broad cleanup of real ~/.asd outside the explicitly tested workspace data roots.
No changing configured AI providers or executing non-Codex host agents.
